card.title: Remember Me Correctly
card.instruction: Create small tests of whether someone remembers your preferences, stories, or shared history.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before you take the tea through, which cup is mine?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can you just take one? Everyone's waiting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Twelve years of breakfast together. Which one have I always used?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The blue one. Your name's underneath.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Correct, but turn it upright. How much milk? I haven't written that on the handle.

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The blue one. Your name's underneath.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Correct, but turn it upright. How much milk? I haven't written that on the handle.

mechanism: A tests memory of personal breakfast habits and removes the visible answer cue before the next test.
confusable: Unlike asking for tea preparation, A must judge what B remembers rather than merely get the drink made.
comparison: D83-a moves from labeled cup to unwritten milk preference; D83-b moves from a caption request to a prompted shared quotation.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
